issues.title: Ingest Desha County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $9,521,364 across 25 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($4,547,925), Road Fund ($1,800,000), Solid Waste Fund ($1,346,700). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
